gate_decision.required: macro gain at least 0.01 and no scene regression larger than 0.01
gate_decision.decision: reject without parameter sweep or full-four expansion

interpretation: Entropy gating solves the logical defect of hard mutual exclusion and is effectively non-destructive, but the listwise correction is negligible.
